product.title: Grand Canyon Full Day Small Group Tour & Hike

description.text: Join a small group for a full day on the South Rim combining shuttle transport, rim overlooks, and a guided hike below the rim. Stops include Mather Point, Yavapai Geology Museum, Desert View Watchtower, and a section of the South Kaibab Trail tailored to group fitness.

highlights: Small-group South Rim tour with certified guide
Guided hike below the rim on South Kaibab Trail
Mather Point and Yavapai Geology Museum stops
Desert View Watchtower visit on Desert View Drive

start.description: Pickup from select Tusayan and Grand Canyon Village hotels. Confirm your pickup window when booking.

end.description: Return to your Tusayan or Grand Canyon Village pickup point after the final rim stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Join a small group for a full day on the South Rim combining shuttle transport, rim overlooks, and a guided hike below the rim.

itineraryItems.title: Mather Point
itineraryItems.description: Begin at Mather Point for introductory views of the main canyon expanse.

itineraryItems.title: South Kaibab Trail
itineraryItems.description: Hike a guided section below the rim on the South Kaibab Trail.

itineraryItems.title: Grand Canyon Desert View Watchtower
itineraryItems.description: Visit the stone Desert View Watchtower at the eastern end of the South Rim.

itineraryItems.title: Yavapai Point
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Yavapai Point for unobstructed views toward the inner gorge.

itineraryItems.title: Yavapai Geology Museum
itineraryItems.description: Explore exhibits explaining canyon rock layers and formation at the geology museum.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Grand Canyon Full Day Small Group Tour & Hike?
faqs.answer: The planned duration is 6 to 8 hours.

faqs.question: Where does the tour depart from at the Grand Canyon?
faqs.answer: Pickup from select Tusayan and Grand Canyon Village hotels. Confirm your pickup window when booking.
